question: WLAN planning has requirements on signal field strength in coverage areas. For example, the signal field strength in key areas ranges from -40 dBm to -75 dBm, and that in common areas exceeds -85 dBm. A. True B. False
An antenna converts pilot waves on transmission lines into electromagnetic waves propagated in unbounded media (free space in most cases), or vice versa. A. True B. False
OFDMA and MU-MIMO are mutually exclusive technologies that cannot be configured together. A. True B. False
The management VILAN is used to transmit packets that are forwarded through CAPWAP tunnels, including management packets and service data packets forwarded through CAPWAP tunnels. A. True B. False
In direct forwarding mode, user data packets are encapsulated in a CAPWAP tunnel and then forwarded by the AC to the upper-layer network. A. True B. False

WLAN technology uses radio waves to transmit information over the air and uses the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequency bands. The 5 GHz frequency band here refers to Fifth Generation (5G) technology. A. True B. False
On a WLAN where there are only one AP and two STAs, the two STAs can hear each other but one STA is not in the coverage area of the AP. For the AP, this STA is a hidden node. A. True B. False

Which of the following items does not need to be checked if an AP fails to obtain an IP address through DHCP? A. Whether the link between the AP and AC is properly connected. B. Whether the uplink port of the AP is correctly configured. C. Whether the CAPWAP tunnel configuration between the AP and AC is correct. D. Whether a management VLAN is configured for the AP and AC.
The source IP address is mandatory to an AC’s establishment of CAPWAP tunnels with APs. How many source IP addresses can be assigned to an AC? A. 1 B. 2 C. 3 D. 4

Which of the following configurations can be used to correctly implement MAC address authentication over APs that attempt to go online? A. [AC6508-wlan-view]ap-auth mode mac-auth B. [AC6508-wlan-view]ap auth-mode mac-auth C. [AC6S08]ap auth mode mac-auth D. [AC6508]ap auth-mode mac-auth

An office houses 150 2.4 GHz users with a user concurrency rate of 60%. It is required that the bandwidth per capita be 2 Mbps on the downlink and 1 Mbps on the uplink. Assuming that 20 users are connected to each AP and interference is not taken into account, at least how many APs must be deployed to meet capacity requirements? A. 2 B. 3 C. 4 D. 5

Which of the following statements about the ESS is true? A. ESSs are basic WLAN units. B. The ESS identifies an AP. C. BSSs in an ESS can have different SSIDs. D. The ESS is composed of BSSs as basic units and is a method of expanding the BSS range.

Which of the following statements about CAPWAP functions is false? A. It enables APs to discover an AC. B. It maintains the connectivity state between the AC and APs. B. It enables APs to exchange data sent by STAs with the AC through CAPWAP tunnels when the direct forwarding mode is used. C. It enables the AC to manage APs and deliver service configurations to them.

Which of the following statements about the Fat AP architecture is true? A. A Fat AP must work with an AC. B. Fat APs are applicable to medium and large sized enterprises because they are easy to manage and maintain. C. Fat APs support automatic radio calibration, load balancing, and Layer 3 roaming. D. A Fat AP can implement user access, as well as encrypt and forward service data.
Which of the following 802.11 fames is used to receive data packers by a STA working, in power-saving mode? A. RTS B. CTS C. ACK D. PS-Poll

Which of the following statements about carriers is false? A. A carrier is an electromagnetic wave that is modulated to transmit a signal, and its waveform is typically a sine wave. B. Carrier signals can be produced by modulating the three components (frequency bandwidth, frequency, and phase) of electromagnetic waves. C. Carriers are the physical basis and bearer tool for transmitting voice and data information. D. The receiver end needs to parse carrier signals to obtain data.
Which of the following is not a type of frame defined in 802.11? A. Connection frame B. Management frame C. Control frame D. Data frame

Which of the following statements about inter-AC roaming is false? A. If a mobility server is specified, you need to configure a mobility group on the mobility server and add member ACs to the group, without the need to specify the mobility server on the member ACs. B. If a mobility server is specified, configure a mobility group for each member AC. C. All APs involved in roaming must be configured with the same security policy. D. All APs involved in roaming must be configured with the same SSID.

Which of the following statements about Huawei’s agile distributed Wi-Fi solution is false? A. The solution applies to sites with densely distributed rooms, such as dormitories, hotels, and wards. B. The agile distributed architecture of the solution divides a traditional AP into two independent devices: a central AP and remote unit (RU). C. If an AC has a license that supports management of 100 APs, the AC can manage a maximum of 100 RUs. D. The central AP connects to RUs in rooms through network cables without wall penetration loss or feeder loss, providing high-quality signal coverage.

Which of the following statement, about PSK authentication is true? A. A unique key can be assigned to each user attempting to get connected to the same SSID. B. There is no need to pre-configure a key on the STA and AP. C. WPA supports PSK authentication. D. WEP supports PSK authentication.
Which of the following commands are typically used to test network connectivity? (Choose all that apply.) A. display B. reset C. ping D. tracert

Which of the following statements about antenna polarization are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. An antenna emits electromagnetic waves to the surrounding space. The electric field vector follows a regular rhythm of changes. B. Antenna polarization refers to the magnetic field vector generated when an antenna radiates power. C. If the electric field vector of the radio wave is perpendicular to the ground, the radio wave is a vertical polarized wave. D. A dual-polarized antenna integrates two antennas whose polarization directions are perpendicular to each other to maximize the diversity gains and save installation space.
Which of the following profiles can be associated with an AP group? (Choose all that apply.) A. SSID profile B. VAP profile C. Security profile D. Regulatory domain profile

Which of the following statements about AC VRRP HSB are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. The active/standby mode is supported. B. Load balancing mode is supported. C. User data is backed up in real time. D. Configuration synchronization is supported.

Which of the following statements about ISM frequency bands are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. ISM frequency bands are reserved for international, scientific, and medical (ISM) purposes. B. ISM frequency bands lower WLAN costs but bring a lot of co channel interference. C. No license or fee is required for using ISM frequency bands. D. The 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequency bands used by WLAN both belong to ISM frequency bands.

Which of the following statements are true about 802.1X authentication? (Choose all that apply.) A. 802.1X authentication is implemented based on a client/server architecture. B. 802.1X authentication is applicable to large enterprise networks. C. 802.1X authentication involves three authentication entities: requester (terminal), authenticator (WLAN device), and authentication server (RADIUS). D. PSK authentication is more secure than 802.1X authentication.

Which of the following statements about WLAN roaming are false? (Choose all that apply.) A. APs with which a STA is associated before and after roaming must work on the same channel. B. APs with which a STA is associated before and after roaming can work on different channels. C. During roaming, the STA sends a Reassociation Request frame containing home AP information to the foreign AP. D. During roaming, the STA sends an Association Request frame containing home AP information to the foreign AP.

The following figure shows the hardware structure of an AirEngine 8760-X1 -PRO. Which of the following statements about components of the AirEngine 8760-X1-PRO are true? (Choose all that apply.) A. 4: DC power input B. 8: IoT slots C. 1: Anti-theft lock hole D. 6: Reset button

The following displays online information and type information about an AP. Assume that the AP fails to provide the WLAN service due to an unexpected fault. An engineer intends to restart the AP to restore the WLAN service. Which of the following commands can be used to restart the AP? (Choose all that apply.) A. ap-reset ap-id 115 B. ap-reset ap-group default C. ap-reset all D. ap-reset ap-type type-id 0

Which of the following statements about WLAN and Wi-Fi is true? A. WLAN and Wi-Fi are identical technologies. B. Wi-Fi is an implementation of the WLAN standard. C. WLAN is short for wireless local authentication network. D. WLAN is a type of Wi-Fi technology.

Which of the following statements about the AirEngine 5760-22W is false? A. It supports independent radio scanning. B. It has a maximum device rate of 5.37 Gbps. C. It can be mounted on a junction box or wall. D. It can work in Fit, Fat, or cloud mode.
